College of Mechanical Engineering​ Editor Notes: The School pays special attention to basic theories, professional knowledge, practicality, innovativeness and global vision. There are 3 departments, 7 research institutes, 6 national and provincial research platforms and is equipped with over 140 professors. The School is participated in government research to respond to social need. The School has achieved lots of high level prizes and awards in research. The School has also cooperated with international universities and research institutes from USA,Japan, Europe, Hong Kong, Taiwan. 2-3 international academic conferences are hosted by the School each year. 7.
